name: seller.draft.patchProgressive
title: Profile: seller.draft.patchProgressive
description: Canonical profile for incremental seller draft editing.
text:
# seller.draft.patchProgressive

TL;DR:
- Use this when the seller flow resembles the app and draft fields appear gradually.
- Patch only the fields that changed.

This profile is for progressive seller editing over time.
whenToUse: The agent is confirming one or two fields at a time.
recommended: Reuse the same draft id for the whole editing session.
Send only changed fields in patch.
avoid: Do not resend the whole draft unless needed.
Do not lose the draft id between calls.
exampleInterpretation: The response is the new full draft state after applying the patch.
